title: Baked Pork Chops in Mushroom Sauce
description: These oven-baked pork chops in mushroom sauce are seared in a cast iron skillet and smothered in a rich tomatoey sauce for a quick weeknight meal.
ingredients: 1 (26.5 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 medium sweet onion (such as Vidalia®), thinly sliced

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Place a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat. Mist pork chops with olive oil cooking spray and season with garlic powder, paprika, and chili powder. Cook pork chops in the hot skillet, turning frequently, until lightly browned on both sides, 5 to 8 minutes total. Transfer to a casserole or baking dish.
Mix together condensed soup and tomatoes in a large bowl until well combined. Pour over pork chops and place onion slices on top. Cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil.

Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes. Remove foil and continue to bake until pork is tender, 5 to 10 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center of a pork chop should read at least 145 degrees F (63 degrees C).

video.description: In this video, learn how to make a delicious version of baked pork chops in mushroom sauce. These chops get a quick sear in a hot skillet and then cook slowly in the oven to make them amazingly tender with wonderful flavor. The recipe works well on those busy afternoons when you want a hearty dish that tastes like you worked all day. For a quick and easy meal, serve it over white rice or mashed potatoes.
